notes: Three generations together, 50th anniversary celebrated, zero major issues. Family is already asking about the next reunion.
school_feedback: Maria reported the family loved the welcome dinner setup and the formal night photo. Several family members said this was the best reunion ever.
what_worked: Pre-cruise welcome dinner set the tone perfectly. Cabanas at CocoCay were worth the cost. Memory books were a huge hit. Group dining tables together every night kept the family connected.
what_to_improve: A few family units arrived late to Miami due to flight delays. Need a clearer arrival window communication. Some kids wanted more time at Atlantis pools.
do_next_time: Build in a half-day buffer in Miami before cruise embarkation to handle late arrivals. Book Atlantis as a full day excursion rather than partial. Consider adding a second formal night.
do_not_repeat: Do not book specialty dining for groups of 38 in one seating - too loud and service was rushed. Avoid scheduling activities the same time as muster drill.
